title: How a Sink P-Trap Protects Your Home
description: A sink P-trap relies on simple physics to keep sewer gases out of your living space. As water flows down the sink drain, a small volume remains trapped in the dip of the pipe, creating a permanent liquid seal. When waste flows through, gravity carries water down while fresh water replaces the existing trap volume. The trapped water completely blocks air movement from the sewer side to the fixture side, while allowing smooth drainage. Understanding this simple barrier helps plumbers troubleshoot drainage noise, siphonage issues, and dry traps.
